title: GTM MCP Directory company page (SteadyBase public company-v1)
description: Field lock from GTM Signals / SteadyBase. Use these names exactly. Do not invent synonyms. Public-company intel source of record is fin45 / GTM Signals Postgres, not this repo. This file is the personal-directory presentation layer plus an MCP explainer. directory.json beats this file for MCP honesty and tool counts.

slug.description: Presentation URL id only. Page lives at /gtm-directory/companies/{slug}/. Not a SteadyBase synonym for account_id or legal_name.

account_id.description: Feed value only from fin45 / GTM Signals. null if missing. NEVER invent acc_ from slug.

legal_name.description: Legal / display name. Not the synonym legal.

ticker.description: Optional listed ticker. Only when a public filing or the existing PUBLIC_COMPANIES map already has it.

cik.description: Optional SEC CIK. Only from a public filing. Do not invent.

domain.description: Registrable vendor domain. Must match directory vendor_domain on every linked tool that has one.

linkedin_company_url.description: From identity.linkedin_url only when it is a LinkedIn company or school page. Do not invent.

entry_point_account_id.description: Proved parent account_id if that parent already has an id, else this record's account_id, else abstain (null). Never a tenant go-after id.

why_now.description: Verbatim quotes with a resolvable receipt. Abstain (empty array) if the quote is weak or unpublished.

executives.description: Filing-roster or licensed sources only. No email or phone on public pages.

tools.description: Directory overlay. Pointers at existing directory.json entries. Not a SteadyBase synonym.

honesty_badge.description: Directory overlay. Must match the badge derived from linked directory entries. n-a is not a company badge.

category_tags.description: Directory overlay. Category slugs and/or job slugs already on the linked entries.

notes.description: Optional editorial note. Must not invent MCP status, tool counts, quotes, executives, or family nodes.

parent_account_id.description: Only if a proved parent already has a feed account_id. Do not invent acc_ from a slug.

subsidiaries.description: Proved nodes only (EX-21 or equivalent). legal_name is enough; do not invent ids.

account_id.description: Feed id when the proved node already has one. null if the name is proved and the id is not. Do not invent acc_ from a slug.

proof.description: Why this node is proved (for example EX-21). Required when the node is not a placeholder.

quote.description: Verbatim public quote. Abstain rather than paraphrase.

receipt_url.description: Resolvable public URL for the quote.

as_of.description: ISO date the quote was current.

source.description: Filing roster or licensed source. Required when placeholder is not true.

executive.description: No email. No phone. Public pages never carry those fields.

mcp_package_hint.description: Locator an agent uses to pull the same package. No official status. No tool counts.

slug.description: Company page slug. Must match the record slug.

listing_url.description: Directory listing for the primary linked tool: https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/tools/{tool-slug}

mcp_url.description: Connect URL copied from the primary linked directory entry. null if that entry has none. Not a status and not a count.

ticker.description: Include when the company record has a ticker.

domain.description: Include when the company record has a domain.

entry_id.description: Optional directory.json entry id, e.g. 06-hubspot. When set, must match the resolved slug.

last_enriched.description: ISO date of the last company-record enrich on this presentation layer.

source_of_record.description: Where public-company intel will come from. Default: fin45 / GTM Signals Postgres. This repo does not replace that.

enrichment_scope.description: Company-level only for now. No contact, no tenant book, no ICP.
